verdict.rationale: SolidJS is a UI rendering framework, not an agent or AI host. Plugging in MCP servers so the product itself can use their tools is a client-side agent role outside this product category. Nothing in the evidence shows SolidJS shipping any MCP client or tool-consuming capability that would make the axis applicable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
